Durable ranged barrel.

Ranged shotgun barrel.

perks.name: Accurized Rounds

This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Appended Mag

This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Fourth Time's the Charm
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return two rounds to the magazine.

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.desc: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 133 from 11 March 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/49VFDRj05iDXTJDOBqQpga?si=e61731a19fb64938) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec M+KB Controller): Backup PvE pick for sustained damage against bosses in both general at-level or better, and end-game underlevelled content. First thing to say is that Keen Thistle, while a decent sniper rifle, is an aggressive frame and so not currently a meta pick for DPS. At base, the stats are good by comparison with its peers - 77 Range and 35 Zoom (so a much more open sight than usual), 31 Stability is ×1.1124 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 31 Handling is 0.43s ready, 0.44s ADS and 0.37s stow speed, 33 Reload Speed is a 3.15s reload, Recoil Direction is 75, and base magazine size is 3 (max 5). With 0/1/2/3 reserves mods, total ammo is 24/26/27/27 (max 27). Use the barrel perk to improve Handling, and then the magazine perk to increase magazine size to the max of 5 with Adept Backup Mag. If you do want to keep a roll for boss damage, in case of a future buff, then the combination of Envious Arsenal (when enhanced, that counts as a extra reserve mod too) and Bait and Switch, as part of a weapon rotation, refills all your weapons and boosts damage by ×1.3 for 10s (11s with enhanced B+S), or Vorpal Weapon for an always-on ×1.15 damage against Majors and Bosses. The reworked Skulking Wolf origin trait can be useful in PvE, making enemies less accurate when firing at you for 10s after getting a kill while at low health, or if you're soloing content, Alacrity provides excellent gunfeel boosts: +20 to Range and Stability, +50 to Reload Speed and +10 to Aim Assist. Recommended MW: Handling with an Adept Backup Mag mod. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "While this isn't the best PvE sniper, you can still find niche uses with Triple Tap and Vorpal Weapon, or Bait and Switch. It's not the best because this archetype isn't the meta, but it's high damage means each shot will certainly count." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Keen Thistle does have some great options for becoming your next sniper. Snapshot and Opening Shot or Moving Target are both good tried and true options. Closing Time is the best option for if you don't get ammo often as it requires you to be at 1 ammo, or 2 with a magazine boosting perk. Slickdraw is my favorite sniper perk because it forces you to be a little more accurate but gives you all the benefits of old Quickdraw. I understand the community is divided on Slickdraw." Recommended MW: Handling.
